problem: A GitHub Actions CI pipeline using a matrix strategy works on pushes to the main branch but intermittently fails on pull requests from forked repositories because fork PRs receive a read-only GITHUB_TOKEN that cannot create check runs or write to the repository.
query: resource not accessible by integration GITHUB_TOKEN pull_request fork permissions
reasoning: Using GitHub issues search to find the actual issue reports and discussions about GITHUB_TOKEN permissions on fork PRs. The actions/runner and community repos have detailed threads with workarounds (pull_request_target, workflow_run, etc.).
command: ./websearch --no-cache -p github -m issues "resource not accessible by integration GITHUB_TOKEN pull_request fork permissions"
